recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed unless a future work group decision revises the broader Implementation Guide definition beyond the specific wording expansion approved in FHIR-24868.
issue_request: FHIR-24868 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for the conformance module definition of Implementation Guide. It objected that the original list of publishers, "domain, institution or vendor," did not clearly include public health authorities, governments, alliances, consortia, and similar organizations. The approved resolution was to expand the list to "domain, institution, vendor, consortium, or other organization."
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied by git commit dc9ec0ba14b6f966b510248298d0256240a570a5, which changed source/conformance-module.html from "domain, institution or vendor" to "domain, institution, vendor, consortium, or other organization". Current source still contains that expanded wording.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists conformance-module.html as the active Conformance module page, confirming build scope. Current-source searches did not find another occurrence of the old conformance-module definition needing reconciliation, and Zulip/Confluence searches for the issue key and phrase-level terms found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/conformance-module.html already implements the Jira resolution at the relevant definition. The published commit is an empty no-change audit record.
